no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken to an AC as neither efficacy nor safety issues arose necessitating a public discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for RYDAPT (midostaurin, NDA207997). The Summary Review states the application was not taken to an AC because neither efficacy nor safety issues arose necessitating public discussion, and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Medical Review, and Risk review all concur that midostaurin was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants. Accordingly, no AdComm concerns influenced the approval.
